name: Probabilistic Subspace Filtering

content_codebook.patient_residual: retain original backbone content path; do not replace it by codebook reconstruction

basis.GGN: Lambda=0.01 I + Jcov.T diag(sigmoid(r)*(1-sigmoid(r))) Jcov / n_cov_rows
basis.basis: B=Sigma^0.5 Vtop16 of Sigma^0.5 Jprobe.T Jprobe Sigma^0.5
basis.covariance_claim: local pooled-logit surrogate covariance only; not calibrated target posterior or whole network Laplace

observation.definition: concat(d32, soft style reconstruction32, mean content reconstruction64)
observation.outputs: first16=observation o; last16 bounded logit for Rdiag in [1e-4,10]

transition.inference: causal information-form Gaussian update only; no smoothing

calibration.parameter: single log temperature of observation R, tau=0.25+3.75*sigmoid(a), Rcal=tau^2*R
calibration.fit: Gaussian NLL of source cal projected oracle under causal filtered state; only temperature updated

static: reset m=0,P=I before each visit; keep learned F/Q; separately train at same budget
main_ablation: A_ISO_OBS: replace R by I*trace(R)/16 at every visit, retain full checkpoint; posterior P can still be non-isotropic
falsifiers: FULL fails to improve prepared STATIC under matched information
filter uncertainty increases confidence on larger held-out source code errors
content changes at same synthetic acquisition cause systematic harmful state shifts
